summary: Steep 10 m kerb on the bridge approach, no parked cars or pull-off.
reasons: Route to motorway bridge, no parked cars
Kerb meets bush, no room to pull off

drivers.seclusion: Bush on this side and the motorway to the east; homes over 40 m away.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow lane with kerb-to-bush edge; no verge wide enough for a van.
drivers.traffic: Through road feeding the bridge, with motorway noise.
drivers.convention: No signs; no cars parked along it.

flags: Only 10 m long, under a van's turning room
sun_shade: Dense tree canopy over the kerb, shaded from the north and east.
